html:
The Mohegan are an Algonquian people of southeastern Connecticut, along the Thames River. They were once part of the Pequot, from whom they split in the early 1600s under the leader Uncas. They are a different people from the Mohican of the Hudson valley, despite the similar name.

Uncas allied with the English colonists. In the Pequot War of 1636 to 1638 the Mohegan fought beside the English, and in 1643 Uncas defeated the Narragansett sachem Miantonomo and had him killed. The Mohegan also sided with the colonists in King Philip's War of 1675 to 1676. In return they kept some land, though colonists later took much of it.

In the 1700s the Mohegan minister Samson Occom raised money in Britain for Eleazar Wheelock's Indian school, money that went to found Dartmouth College, and later led Christian Natives to found Brothertown. The Mohegan Tribe won federal recognition in 1994 and opened the Mohegan Sun casino in 1996.
